themes.name: Almanac
themes.material: cool slate stock, two rule weights, Hanken Grotesk heads over Newsreader prose, tabular figures in mono, one library-stamp blue
themes.signature: a hairline table with one firm rule under its head and figures lined up to the decimal

themes.name: Arcade
themes.material: an aubergine CRT with a visible grille, marquee lettering, ember and acid chevron side art, a pixel HUD
themes.signature: the lit marquee band with an RGB-split wordmark over a chevron side-art panel

themes.name: Atelier
themes.material: warm plaster paper, umber ink, a bold Sentient crown over Hanken Grotesk, hairlines and air, one cool slate signal
themes.signature: a large weighted serif line over a hairline-framed object with its placard set small beneath it

themes.name: Bloom
themes.material: warm off-white paper under two terracotta blooms, Figtree throughout, one roman Gambarino line, raised warm cards
themes.signature: warm light on light paper, a plain sans headline with one serif sentence beneath it, the made thing on a raised warm card

themes.name: Blueprint
themes.material: prussian-blue sheet under a two-pitch grid, white line drawing, a fixed title block, dimension strings and hatch fills
themes.signature: the fixed title block in the sheet's corner, with every figure on the page dimensioned like a drawing
themes.pictured: Bento Grid set as one drawing sheet, Stage hero

themes.name: Broadside
themes.material: grained cream stock, ink rules at one point or five, wood type stacked three faces deep, one vermilion, everything centred
themes.signature: a bill set to the measure: big lines fitted edge to edge under a five-point rule, three vermilion diamonds dividing one bill from the next

themes.name: Brutal
themes.material: an engineered near-white sheet carved by 3px near-black rules, giant uppercase Albert Sans 700, zero radius, one acid-yellow fill
themes.signature: a solid ink block butted against a bordered paper block with one acid-yellow bar between them

themes.name: Carnival
themes.material: tinted paper, a duo-tone pair that competes instead of blending, Big Shoulders Display 800 in its heavy width, 2px rules, a flat ink shadow offset four pixels
themes.signature: the duo, mustard against oxblood, each on a 4px hard ink shadow, given to whatever the page pairs (two formats, two acts, two dates), never a fixed pair of tiles

themes.name: Cobalt
themes.material: cool engineered near-white, hairlines instead of boxes, Familjen Grotesk over IBM Plex Sans, a graphite code surface in JetBrains Mono, one electric cobalt signal
themes.signature: a graphite request and response pair under a filename caption, with one cobalt syntax token, hairline-framed on cool white

themes.name: Console
themes.material: blue-black ground in three lightness steps, Host Grotesk for reading, mono for what was measured, amber for a person and a cool blue for an instrument
themes.signature: a hairline panel cut into a grid by 1px gaps, a reading in mono with its unit and time, and one amber button

themes.name: Coral
themes.material: warm grey paper, one coral signal, General Sans throughout, soft pills
themes.signature: an ink-filled pill beside an outlined one, and nothing else on the page is coloured

themes.name: Darkroom
themes.material: near-black wall with a fine grain, hairline extra-condensed capitals, one amber safelight, greyscale prints hung edge to edge
themes.signature: prints hung edge to edge on the near-black wall at one height, each with its plate number and date beneath in the body face

themes.name: Dose
themes.material: white paper with pale green tint bands, one pharmacy green, a rounded grotesk, dose pills in a week grid, the app bleeding off its slot
themes.signature: a week grid of small green pills, filled when taken and outlined when due, beside a rounded green cross

themes.name: Editorial
themes.material: warm cream, a heavy condensed grotesque slammed left, 1px hairlines, roman-numeral folios, one coral mark
themes.signature: a condensed headline hard against the left margin, answered by one serif-italic pulled line between two hairlines

themes.name: Formwork
themes.material: a poured concrete surface with board lines and tie holes, condensed caps in ink, one safety orange on plates and numbers, drawings built from a radius
themes.signature: an orange plate button on a three-pixel cast shadow, set on a concrete surface that shows the lines of its boards

themes.name: Furrow
themes.material: warm office paper, an ink-ruled ledger, Red Hat Display at 600, one tangerine record mark and a yellow ear tag
themes.signature: the ledger row, a mono time first and a chip last, under a single ink rule

themes.name: Garden
themes.material: oat paper, green ink, a sturdy Vollkorn head, a leaf-green signal, clay kept inside hand-built craft
themes.signature: the season bar, twelve months as one ruled bar with the in-season months filled leaf green and the current month marked by a hairline

themes.name: Grid
themes.material: a cool near-white sheet with an exposed 12-column hairline grid, one heavy lowercase grotesk, one signal ink spent on geometry
themes.signature: the visible column rails running behind everything, including across the one flooded plate

themes.name: Halftone
themes.material: cream stock, one spot ink through a dot screen, a fat slab display, three-pixel rules and a nutrition panel as the only box
themes.signature: a fruit drawn as a screened disc in the spot colour, dense on one side and fading to nothing on the other

themes.name: Hedgerow
themes.material: deep hedge green, one chartreuse for every line the code draws, Prata names, Manrope for the reading, a leaf as the unit of quantity
themes.signature: a specimen drawn in 1.2px chartreuse lines beside its name in Prata, one real quantity from the brief (miles, a count) as a row of leaves
themes.pictured: Field guide (an unlisted shape), Stage hero

themes.name: Hum
themes.material: cream pulled toward pear-yellow, three accents that never blend, one rounded sans, round corners everywhere, a press you can feel
themes.signature: the pear-yellow pill with a solid colour edge that lifts on hover and presses down on click

themes.name: Ink
themes.material: white paper, a black with no hue, one teal that means in, Epilogue 700 display, rows on rules, a paper plane
themes.signature: a list that starts on a 1px ink rule and ends each row with a pill, and a single-path paper plane

themes.name: Kiln
themes.material: a near-black ground, a seven-step heat ramp from ash to white heat drawn inside grained plates, Fraunces at full optical size, one smoked plate for the controls
themes.signature: a rounded plate whose lower corner burns from oxblood through ember to white while the page around it stays cold

themes.name: Ledger
themes.material: a ruled navy sheet with money columns, tabular mono on every figure, two inks with one job each, totals footed under a double rule
themes.signature: a column of mono figures closing on a total under a double rule, with an as-of line beneath it

themes.name: Loom
themes.material: ecru paper with a Caslon, a deep indigo, sand and oat as cloth colours, thin rules, a comb of 1px threads as the texture
themes.signature: a bar of indigo threaded with 1px vertical lines at a 12px pitch, carrying the headline of the section

themes.name: Lumen
themes.material: a cool-violet ground with a faint blueprint grid, one built light artefact, lowercase serif heads, molten brass
themes.signature: one hand-built light source standing in dead space, lit from inside, under a lowercase serif headline with one coloured verb

themes.name: Manifesto
themes.material: warm charcoal, condensed uppercase caps at 9rem leaded tight, a quiet grotesque body, one fighting red
themes.signature: a three-line block of condensed caps locked into one solid mass against the left margin, with a single red word in it

themes.name: Midnight
themes.material: midnight-blue ground, cool near-white ink, thin Geist at scale, one azure signal, depth in lightness steps
themes.signature: a Geist 300 headline set large and airy over layered blue-dark surfaces seamed by hairlines

themes.name: Newsprint
themes.material: warm cream stock, a Zilla Slab head over Spectral columns, hairlines and a double rule, one dried-brick mark
themes.signature: a slab-serif drop cap opening a lede split into hairline-ruled columns under a double rule
themes.pictured: Front Page (an unlisted shape), Settled hero

themes.name: Overprint
themes.material: warm newsprint stock, a wide shouted grotesk, two transparent flat inks that print a third where they cross, tickets and stamps
themes.signature: two flat ink shapes overlapping behind or beside the headline, the overlap printing a third colour, nothing out of register

themes.name: Paste-up

themes.name: Piste
themes.material: snow-white paper, cobalt runs and buttons, black condensed caps, blue and red and black grade marks, one cobalt band sweeping the hero
themes.signature: a headline in condensed black caps beside a mountain profile drawn in ink, with the runs on it in cobalt

themes.name: Ribbon
themes.material: warm off-white paper, a light italic serif, pills and rules, and a ribbon of hairline strands in copper and teal whose thickness means loudness

themes.name: Rim
themes.material: warm black paper, one disc lit along a third of its edge, Switzer medium, mono for every measurement, zero radius
themes.signature: the black disc with a hard-edged conic rim, and a 1px horizon rule with something rising under it

themes.name: Riso
themes.material: pink stock, two spot inks a hair out of register, heavy Public Sans over Newsreader, grain on the ink
themes.signature: one focal word overprinted in blue and pink echoes two pixels out of register

themes.name: Saffron
themes.material: a whole page dyed mustard saffron, near-black ink, cream plates, Zodiak Italic on every head, a cropped giant letterform

themes.name: Solstice
themes.material: cream paper with a ring of cream rays, warm brown ink, a low vermilion sun, gold hairlines, panels drawn as bottle labels
themes.signature: a solid vermilion disc sitting in the empty centre of a ring of pale conic rays, with a label panel ruled in gold beside it

themes.name: Specimen
themes.material: warm oat paper, a Didone set enormous and thin, hairlines, one cool ink-blue mark
themes.signature: a single Bodoni Moda word at specimen scale whose hairlines nearly vanish, over a ruled page

themes.name: Spore
themes.material: coffee-ground black under a warm grain, cream Young Serif, one oyster pink, the product drawn in code on brick shelves
themes.signature: a drawn row of the product on a brick shelf (caps, bottles or jars), each name in cream serif and its price in pink

themes.name: Sport
themes.material: cool concrete paper, blue-black ink, uppercase Saira Condensed, tabular mono figures, one volt stripe
themes.signature: a split-time figure set larger than its label beside a single volt lane stripe

themes.name: Squeeze
themes.material: a forest green ground with real chroma, peach controls, Manrope heavy from headline to footnote, drawn fruit with a ripeness bar

themes.name: Sticker

themes.pictured: Bento Grid set as a sticker sheet, Poster hero

themes.name: Studio
themes.material: cool studio-white, a roughened roman serif at scale, hairlines and air, one cadmium-orange rectangle

themes.pictured: Case-study index (an unlisted shape), Settled hero

themes.name: Terminal
themes.material: green-black ground, phosphor-green ink on one hue, every glyph JetBrains Mono, box-drawn chrome, square corners

themes.name: Terrazzo

themes.name: Ultraviolet
themes.material: lavender paper, one saturated violet, Outfit set lowercase, pills, a drawn record and a bar waveform
themes.signature: a lowercase headline beside a vinyl disc whose label is the only violet fill

themes.material: parchment with a fibre wash, gothic display lettering, ultramarine ink, double rules, a woodcut seal and a tilted stamp

themes.name: Wayfind
themes.material: cool grey paper, all-mono type, 2px ink borders, a black signage plate with amber figures, one cobalt

themes.pictured: Board and strip map (an unlisted shape), Settled hero

themes.name: Werkstatt
themes.material: a warm putty grey ground, a blue circle, a red triangle and a yellow square, heavy geometric capitals, 2px and 3px black rules
